headword: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}

definitions.explanation: The spread of disease through direct physical contact with an infected person or by touching contaminated surfaces. A key term in public health and hygiene education.

examples.japanese: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}おう→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: Let's wash our hands to prevent contact transmission.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧{接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: This disease spreads mainly through contact transmission.

examples.japanese: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こまめ→こまめ：10325_komame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧です。
examples.english: To reduce the risk of contact infection, it is important to frequently disinfect in public places.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧ (contact, touching) and ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧ (infection, transmission). Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic as one of the main transmission routes discussed in public health messaging.

There are two subtypes: {直接接触感染|ちょくせつせっしょくかんせん} (direct contact infection, through touching an infected person) and {間接接触感染|かんせつせっしょくかんせん} (indirect contact infection, through contaminated surfaces).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent contact transmission
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk of contact infection
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against contact transmission

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛沫感染|ひまつかんせん}→飛沫感染：24192_himatsukansen⟧: droplet transmission — spread through respiratory droplets
- ⟦{空気感染|くうきかんせん}→空気感染：25169_kuukikansen⟧: airborne transmission — spread through airborne particles
- {経口感染|けいこうかんせん}: oral transmission — spread through ingestion
